title: Cisplatin-induced BRCA1 re-expression and PARPi resistance in constitutionally methylated vs. mutated BRCA1 TNBC
rationale: The reflexion finding establishes that BRCA1-methylated TNBC can restore RAD51 foci and HR capacity after chemotherapy exposure — unlike stable germline BRCA1 mutations. This experiment directly tests the causal chain: cisplatin exposure → BRCA1 epigenetic derepression → RAD51 restoration → olaparib IC50 shift. The two cell lines provide an isogenic-like comparison between epigenetically silenced (SUM149PT) and genetically inactivated (HCC1937) BRCA1.
key_question: Does cisplatin exposure selectively restore BRCA1 expression and HR capacity in constitutionally methylated BRCA1 TNBC (SUM149PT) but NOT in BRCA1-null mutated TNBC (HCC1937), and does this restoration confer measurable olaparib resistance?

cell_lines.BRCA1_status: Constitutional BRCA1 promoter methylation — not mutated; silenced epigenetically
cell_lines.rationale: Models the methylated, HR-deficient state pre-chemotherapy. BRCA1 methylation is retained in this line, enabling measurement of epigenetic reversion upon cisplatin exposure.
cell_lines.source_note: American Type Culture Collection (ATCC) or Asterand Bioscience; confirm BRCA1 methylation status by pyrosequencing before experiment start

cell_lines.BRCA1_status: BRCA1 null — homozygous frameshift mutation (exon 20 5382insC equivalent); no functional BRCA1 protein
cell_lines.rationale: Models stable genetic BRCA1 inactivation. Any cisplatin-induced change in HR capacity in this line is mutation-independent and cannot reflect BRCA1 re-expression — serves as the negative control for the reversibility mechanism.
cell_lines.source_note: Confirm BRCA1 protein absence by Western blot before experiment start (anti-BRCA1, D-9 clone)

step_1_cisplatin_challenge.vehicle: Sterile water (1 mg/mL stock, diluted in complete medium)
step_1_cisplatin_challenge.medium_volume: Standard 6-well or 10 cm dish, 70-80% confluency at treatment start
step_1_cisplatin_challenge.rationale: 5 µM × 72h is an established sub-lethal BRCAness-relevant dose in TNBC cell lines (consistent with prior SUM149PT cisplatin studies); induces sufficient DNA damage stress to trigger epigenetic response without >50% cell death

step_2_wash_recovery.recovery_medium: Complete medium (DMEM/RPMI + 10% FBS as per line requirements)
step_2_wash_recovery.rationale: 7-day recovery mirrors clinical post-NACT interval before adjuvant therapy decision. Allows epigenetic reversion to manifest without acute cisplatin effects on HR protein levels

step_3_olaparib_challenge.readout_timing: IC50 by CellTiter-Glo luminescent viability at 72h post-olaparib
step_3_olaparib_challenge.rationale: Full dose-response captures IC50 shift as the primary pharmacological endpoint. Expected outcome: SUM149PT IC50 shifts right (resistance) post-cisplatin+recovery; HCC1937 IC50 unchanged

experimental_arms.label: SUM149PT — Naive (no cisplatin)
experimental_arms.description: SUM149PT cells treated with vehicle (water) × 72h, then 7-day recovery in complete medium, then olaparib challenge
experimental_arms.expected_IC50: Low (< 5 µM) — BRCA1 methylated, HR-deficient, PARPi sensitive

experimental_arms.label: SUM149PT — Cisplatin-exposed (reversibility test)
experimental_arms.description: SUM149PT cells treated with cisplatin 5 µM × 72h, washed × 3, 7-day recovery, then olaparib challenge
experimental_arms.expected_IC50: Elevated (> 20 µM, shift >= 4-fold vs Arm A) — BRCA1 re-expressed, HR restored, PARPi resistant

experimental_arms.label: HCC1937 — Naive (no cisplatin)
experimental_arms.description: HCC1937 cells treated with vehicle × 72h, then 7-day recovery, then olaparib challenge
experimental_arms.expected_IC50: Low (< 1 µM) — BRCA1 null, constitutively HR-deficient

experimental_arms.label: HCC1937 — Cisplatin-exposed (negative control for reversibility)
experimental_arms.description: HCC1937 cells treated with cisplatin 5 µM × 72h, washed × 3, 7-day recovery, then olaparib challenge
experimental_arms.expected_IC50: Unchanged vs Arm C (< 2-fold shift) — BRCA1 mutation cannot be reversed by epigenetic mechanism

readouts.name: BRCA1 protein expression — Western blot
readouts.method: Western blot; anti-BRCA1 antibody (D-9 clone, Santa Cruz; or MS110, Calbiochem); loading control GAPDH or β-actin
readouts.expected_result: SUM149PT: BRCA1 band appears/increases after cisplatin and remains elevated through recovery. HCC1937: No BRCA1 band at any timepoint.
readouts.quantification: Densitometry normalized to loading control; fold-change vs Day 0 per cell line

readouts.name: BRCA1 mRNA expression — RT-qPCR
readouts.method: RNA extraction (RNeasy), cDNA synthesis, TaqMan or SYBR Green qPCR; primers spanning exon 4-5 junction to avoid genomic DNA amplification; reference genes: GAPDH, RPLP0
readouts.expected_result: SUM149PT: BRCA1 mRNA increases after cisplatin+recovery (epigenetic derepression at transcriptional level). HCC1937: No detectable full-length BRCA1 mRNA.
readouts.quantification: 2^(-ΔΔCt) method; statistical comparison by paired t-test (Day 0 vs Day 7) per cell line

readouts.name: BRCA1 promoter methylation — pyrosequencing
readouts.method: Bisulfite conversion (EpiTect kit), PCR amplification of BRCA1 promoter CpG island (target CpGs including cg21490561), pyrosequencing on PyroMark Q24
readouts.expected_result: SUM149PT: Methylation fraction decreases after cisplatin+recovery (epigenetic reversion mechanism). HCC1937: No signal (methylation assay not informative for mutant allele — confirm N/A at baseline).
readouts.quantification: % methylation per CpG site; plot as methylation heatmap Day 0 vs Day 7; paired t-test on mean methylation % across targeted CpGs

readouts.name: RAD51 foci — immunofluorescence
readouts.method: Cells plated on coverslips or Lab-Tek chamber slides; 6 Gy ionizing radiation (IR) 1h before fixation to induce DSBs; 4% PFA fixation; permeabilization (0.5% Triton X-100); anti-RAD51 antibody (ab63801, Abcam); DAPI nuclear counterstain; confocal or widefield fluorescence microscopy; automated foci counting (ImageJ CellProfiler pipeline)
readouts.threshold: >10 RAD51 foci per nucleus = HR-proficient (BRCAness negative); <=10 foci per nucleus = HR-deficient (BRCAness positive)
readouts.expected_result: SUM149PT Arm A: <= 10 foci/nucleus (HR-deficient pre-treatment). SUM149PT Arm B Day 7: >10 foci/nucleus (HR restored post-cisplatin). HCC1937 Arms C and D: <= 10 foci/nucleus at both timepoints (BRCA1 mutation cannot be reversed).
readouts.quantification: Count >= 50 nuclei per condition; report % HR-proficient cells (>10 foci); statistical comparison by Mann-Whitney U test; Fisher's exact test for proportion above threshold
readouts.technical_note: Use the Castroviejo-Bermejo 2018 (PMID 30171200) pre-extraction protocol (CSK buffer wash before fixation) to reduce soluble nuclear RAD51 background and increase foci specificity

readouts.name: Olaparib IC50 — viability dose-response
readouts.method: CellTiter-Glo 2.0 luminescent cell viability assay (Promega); 96-well plate format; 9-point olaparib dose-response (0.001–100 µM, half-log dilutions); 72h drug exposure; GraphPad Prism nonlinear regression (log[inhibitor] vs. normalized response, variable slope 4-parameter Hill equation)
readouts.expected_result: SUM149PT Arm A IC50: 1–5 µM. SUM149PT Arm B IC50: >20 µM (minimum 4-fold shift to confirm resistance). HCC1937 Arms C and D IC50: <1 µM with <2-fold shift between arms.
readouts.primary_endpoint: IC50 fold-change Arm B / Arm A in SUM149PT; IC50 fold-change Arm D / Arm C in HCC1937
readouts.statistical_analysis: Three independent biological replicates; IC50 values log-transformed before analysis; two-way ANOVA (cell line × treatment) with Tukey post-hoc correction; p < 0.05 threshold

controls.control: Vehicle control (water) for cisplatin — Arms A and C
DMSO vehicle control for olaparib — 0.1% v/v maximum
Positive control for HR-deficiency: BRCA2 siRNA-transfected SUM149PT (48h siRNA knockdown before olaparib, not after cisplatin) — confirms foci assay sensitivity

DNMT inhibitor control: 5-azacytidine (5-AZA, 1 µM × 72h) in SUM149PT — confirms BRCA1 promoter methylation is the mechanism driving re-expression (5-AZA should phenocopy cisplatin on BRCA1 expression without DNA damage)

timeline.week_minus_1: Cell line validation — BRCA1 status confirmation (Western blot, pyrosequencing baseline), mycoplasma testing, cisplatin dose-response pilot (establish 5 µM achieves 20-40% viability reduction without complete kill)
timeline.week_1_days_0_to_3: Cisplatin 5 µM treatment (or vehicle) — Arms A/B (SUM149PT), Arms C/D (HCC1937). Collect Day 0 baseline samples (RNA, protein, pyrosequencing) before drug addition.
timeline.week_1_days_3_to_10: 3× PBS wash, recovery in complete medium (change medium Day 5). No drug.
timeline.week_2_day_7: Collect post-recovery samples: R1 Western blot, R2 RT-qPCR, R3 pyrosequencing, R4 RAD51 foci (IR stimulus same day).
timeline.week_3: Data analysis, IC50 curve fitting, statistical testing. Prepare second biological replicate.

sample_size_rationale: n=3 independent biological replicates per arm (12 total conditions). For expected IC50 shift of >= 4-fold (large effect size, Cohen's d >= 1.5 based on pilot data from Frontiers 2023), power analysis (alpha=0.05, power=0.80) requires n=3 biological replicates minimum. Pre-register upgrade to n=6 if pilot effect size is d < 1.0.
novelty_of_experiment: No published study has used the cisplatin-washout-recovery paradigm specifically to test BRCA1 epigenetic reversion in SUM149PT vs HCC1937 as a paired comparison of methylated vs mutated BRCA1 TNBC. The 5-AZA positive control design (mechanistic confirmation arm) and the paired pyrosequencing (methylation fraction change as mechanism readout) are not present in Frontiers 2023 — this design goes beyond the original reversibility observation to establish the epigenetic mechanism as causal.

expected_outcomes.confirm_hypothesis: SUM149PT: BRCA1 re-expressed (Western + RT-qPCR), methylation reduced (pyrosequencing), RAD51 foci restored (>10/nucleus, Day 7), olaparib IC50 >= 4-fold shift. HCC1937: No changes in any readout.
expected_outcomes.partial_support: BRCA1 mRNA increases but olaparib IC50 shift is < 4-fold — suggests partial HR restoration insufficient for full resistance; implies a threshold effect requiring additional recovery time or multiple cisplatin cycles.
expected_outcomes.reject_hypothesis: No IC50 shift in SUM149PT OR equivalent IC50 shift in HCC1937 — would require re-evaluation of HR reversibility mechanism or dose/timing parameters.
expected_outcomes.unexpected_finding_flag: If SUM149PT shows IC50 increase WITHOUT BRCA1 re-expression: suggests BRCA1-independent resistance mechanism post-cisplatin (e.g., MDR upregulation, PARP1 loss) — must be reported and differentiates from the epigenetic reversibility mechanism

clinical_implication: If SUM149PT shows selective BRCA1 re-expression and olaparib resistance post-cisplatin while HCC1937 does not, this provides in vitro mechanistic support for: (1) restricting PARPi eligibility for constitutional BRCA1 methylation-positive TNBC to the treatment-naive setting; (2) using RAD51 foci assay as a dynamic biomarker of PARPi eligibility at each treatment decision point; (3) designing the prospective clinical arm proposed in hyp-tnbc-001-v2 testable_experiment.
regulatory_path: This in vitro experiment is a preclinical proof-of-concept. Successful results would support an IND amendment to an existing olaparib TNBC trial to add a constitutional methylation arm with treatment-naive enrollment restriction and mandatory pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay.
